environment_isolation.base: .venv unchanged; CUDA torch2.7.1+cu128 reused through .pth fallback
environment_isolation.dedicated: .venv-realtime; NumPy2.2.6 and Transformers5.4.0 override all model-facing dependencies

trials.issue: Stable LeRobot0.4.4 pi0-FAST requires patched Transformers custom branch, while Smol requires newer upstream Transformers
trials.decision: Use one official LeRobot main0.6.2 commit for both policies, with matching main-format checkpoints
trials.evidence: v0.4.4 pi0_fast source has transformers.models.siglip.check requirement; both main policy imports passed

trials.issue: LeRobot policies package eagerly imports dataset/video helpers even for inference
trials.observed_failure: Missing av, then av19 AttributeError av.option
trials.decision: Pin official PyAV>=15,<16 (15.1.0) and install NumPy2-compatible pandas2.3.3,pyarrow26,matplotlib3.11.2

trials.issue: CUDA GPU visibility did not imply accelerated OpenGL
trials.observed_failure: EGL renderer llvmpipe; two-camera256 step mean98.47ms
trials.decision: Process-local WSL D3D12 driver/NVIDIA adapter selection; record actual GL_RENDERER

trials.issue: GPU rendering still exceeded physical control deadlines
trials.decision: Preserve official cameras/scene and render separate state snapshots in a spawned latest-only camera process

trials.issue: Async camera frames can lag physical state and cross episode resets
trials.decision: Use physical snapshot capture_time,tick,episode_id; restore both camera and proprio from the same state; root filters obsolete episode IDs
trials.evidence: Camera snapshot parity is byte-identical for twoRGB and threeproprio sensors; tests verify timestamp/identity copying

trials.issue: A bounded multiprocessing queue can be full before feeder bytes are readable
trials.decision: Drop a new submission during that race rather than block control; otherwise evict pending sample and retain newest
trials.evidence: test_camera_worker.py feeder race and latest-mailbox tests

limits: Five-second hold-action smoke proves timing separation, not learned-policy task success.
Sensor scene clone and baseline scene use identical official task/assets/resolution, but async sensor timing is a declared separate condition.
Deadline behavior under simultaneous model inference requires full-runner evaluation.
Desktop Python/ROS/D3D12 pipeline is soft realtime; it is not a hard-realtime safety claim.
